errors.evidence: The description states that the blue markers start at approximately 520,000 in 2018. However, the chart shows the blue marker for 2018 is at a value of approximately 590,000, slightly above the solid blue line which is at 580,000. The value 520,000 corresponds to the minimum value of the solid blue line in the year 2020.
